items.title: Marco Capital appoints Rob Gibbs as PoloWorks chief executive
items.summary: Rob Gibbs joins PoloWorks from SiriusPoint to lead the insurance services group through its combination with Pro Global.

items.title: LMA research highlights gap between leadership readiness and senior underwriting roles
items.summary: Lloyd's Market Association figures show the pool of women ready for senior underwriting roles has grown to 25%, while representation in top posts has slipped.

items.title: Nine in ten mid-market firms face disruption, Chubb research shows
items.summary: Chubb's risk radar reveals widespread disruption among mid-market firms, alongside strong growth plans and a notable insurance gap in overseas operations.

items.title: CILA launches Accredited Training Organisation programme for loss adjusters
items.summary: The Chartered Institute of Loss Adjusters has introduced a new accreditation scheme for employers, with Crawford & Company Adjusters becoming the first participant.
